title: Yaadan Reh Gaiyaan Char Chafere
body:
Yaadan reh gayiaan, char chafere
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran di jaga iss vere wich, mantaan de diway ya ne, keetay vaseray
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatima de saray sooraj, karbala turr gaye
Nayi hunn chiragaan nal mukne, maa fatima de ghar chon, veer handere
<<DIVIDER>>
Ayaat e tatheer jeewain, vekh di si kisa
Chan veer madinay wich aywain, sughra nay roz raste, vekhay bathayray
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu mera khat par na sakheya, zindagi muk gayi
Par bhen da veeran vada ay, duniya paray ghi nohay, meray te teray
